name: CUE SAMPLER (Beta) — Windows 10/11 x64
description:
Windows 10/11 x64. Installer format: VST3. A compatible 64-bit VST3 host is required. Download from your Gumroad library and check the installer source; if Windows reports an unrecognized publisher or another security warning, contact support rather than bypassing it.

CUE SAMPLER is beta software for chopping and playing samples. It provides automatic tempo and key estimates, editable grids and cue points, MIDI mapping, and on-device AI stem separation. Analysis can need manual adjustment; stem processing time varies with the source and hardware.

Beta release: Back up your projects before use. Check your operating system and DAW requirements before purchase. No native AAX version for Pro Tools is supplied.
